name: refdex
description: Method-level code index for AI assistants (Claude Code, Copilot) via MCP

refdex.include.markdownDescription: When set, only paths matching one of these patterns are indexed (`.gitignore` syntax, relative to the workspace root), for example `src/` or `services/**/*.cs`. Empty means everything.

refdex.exclude.markdownDescription: Extra paths to leave out of the index, in `.gitignore` syntax relative to the workspace root (for example `generated/` or `**/*.test.ts`). `.gitignore` files and folders such as `node_modules`, `dist`, `bin`, `obj` and `.venv` are always excluded.

refdex.watch.description: Keep the index up to date automatically when files change. When off, use Generate / Regenerate Index to update it.

enumDescriptions: Offer the tools once the indexed code reaches refdex.aiToolsMinTokens. On a small codebase they cost more tokens than they save.
Always offer the tools, whatever the codebase size.
Never offer the tools; AI clients read files directly.
refdex.aiTools.markdownDescription: When AI clients (Copilot, Claude Code) get RefDex's tools. Their definitions are sent with every request, about 1,200 tokens, so on a small codebase reading files is cheaper. `auto` offers them once the code reaches `#refdex.aiToolsMinTokens#`.

refdex.aiToolsMinTokens.markdownDescription: Size of the indexed source code, in estimated tokens (about 4 characters each), from which `auto` offers RefDex's tools to AI clients. The default, 100,000 (about 400 KB of code), is a starting point until measured: below it, reading files usually costs less than the tools' fixed overhead.

refdex.languages.description: Languages to index. Empty means all supported languages.

refdex.neo4j.uri.markdownDescription: Neo4j server for **Load into Neo4j**, as a Bolt address. The default is Neo4j on this computer: the Docker Compose setup in the README, or Neo4j Desktop. For Neo4j Aura or another server online, use its `neo4j+s://` address (TLS). **Connect to Neo4j…** sets this, the username and the password.

refdex.neo4j.username.markdownDescription: Neo4j username. The password is not a setting: RefDex keeps it in VS Code's secret storage (your operating system's keychain) after **Connect to Neo4j…**. Without one, a server on this computer gets the local default, `refdex-local`.

refdex.neo4j.database.markdownDescription: Neo4j database to load into. Empty means the server's default database (`neo4j`).

refdex.neo4j.app.markdownDescription: The app the workspace's folders are loaded into, as `(:App)-[:HAS_REPOSITORY]->(:Repository)`. Empty means the workspace's name. Folders loaded into the same app can be queried together; loading a folder again replaces only that folder's part.

refdex.neo4j.includeExternal.markdownDescription: Also load uses of names outside the index (library calls, dynamic or ambiguous ones) as `(:External {name})` nodes. Off by default: they are often more than half of all uses.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
